description: Audit given Python file(s)/package scope (FastAPI service, Django project, or plain library) for complete, well-formed PEP 257 docstrings on every public module, package, class, function, method and property — summary line, then `Args:`/`Returns:`/`Yields:`/`Raises:`/`Attributes:` sections in the project's convention (Google unless its Ruff `[tool.ruff.lint.pydocstyle] convention`, a `ruff.toml`, or a `[pydocstyle]` config says `numpy` or `pep257`) — generate any missing or incomplete docstrings grounded in the actual code and current changes, without restating what type hints already say, then verify the result: Ruff's pydocstyle `D` rules run scoped with `--select D` even when the project doesn't enable them (plus the preview pydoclint `DOC` rules as an advisory check for undocumented returns/raises), `interrogate` when the project configures it, and a build of the project's API docs with warnings as errors — Sphinx (autodoc + napoleon, `docs/api/conf.py` per this catalog's scaffold contract, or `docs/conf.py`/`docs/source/conf.py`), MkDocs + mkdocstrings (`mkdocs build --strict`), or pdoc — into a throwaway directory to prove every docstring renders. Framework-aware: Django migrations are never touched; FastAPI route-function docstrings become OpenAPI operation descriptions and Pydantic model docstrings become schema descriptions, so their developer-only sections go after a `\f` (the skill handles the resulting Ruff `D301`); DRF/Ninja view docstrings feed their schema the same way. Detects the runner (`uv run`, `poetry run`, `pdm run`, `pipenv run`, `.venv/bin/`) at runtime. Invoke as `/iru-python-docstrings <path-or-glob>` (comma-separated paths/globs or dotted module names accepted), or `/iru-python-docstrings` with no argument to scope to Python files touched by uncommitted changes plus commits on the current branch not yet on the base branch. Use whenever the user wants docstring completeness checked and filled in for specific Python code, instead of relying on a docs build to surface gaps (Sphinx autodoc silently renders an undocumented member as a bare signature, or skips it).
